plan.title: feat(verification,policy): gate integrity for product oracles - a red verification may not be self-adjudicated by editing the comparison; pass-after-fail-with-method-change is a flagged event

narratives.Description: Extend #3156 to product oracles: a red verification may be resolved only by a product change or an independently re-derived oracle. Add a run-summary verification event. Fail then method-change then pass is flagged. The product AC gate treats comparison-method mutation as unresolved unless independent re-derivation is recorded.
narratives.Overview:
Gate integrity #3156 protects framework gates from being edited to go green. This story extends that rule to the agent-derived product oracle. Evidence: a final equivalence check contradicted an earlier pass; the agent repaired the comparison apparatus instead of the product and shipped a confident success claim the official verifier scored 0.

Rule: a red verification may be resolved only by a product change or an independently re-derived oracle (both sides rebuilt, different method). In-place repair of the failing comparison then pass is unresolved and must be fail-loud (#1006).

The run summary gains a verification event with check id, method fingerprint, and outcome. A fail then method-change then pass sequence on one check id is flagged. The product AC gate treats that mutation as unresolved unless independent re-derivation is recorded. Build and pre-pr carry the MUST/forbid pair via pack source.

Relates #3156, #1006, #3284, #3285, #3282, #3319, #3320.
narratives.UserStory: As a done-gate, I want pass-after-fail-with-method-change flagged, so that an agent cannot self-adjudicate a red product oracle by editing the comparison.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Extend #3156 to product oracles. Add a run-summary verification event (check id, method fingerprint, outcome). Flag fail then method-change then pass. The product AC gate treats comparison-method mutation as unresolved unless independent re-derivation is recorded. Add MUST/forbid to build and pre-pr via pack source then packs render. Cite #3322.

narrative.Acceptance: Run summary records verification attempts with method fingerprints; fail-change-pass on one check id is flaggable.
verify:ac treats discrepancy resolved by comparison-method mutation as unresolved unless independent re-derivation is recorded.
Build and pre-pr carry the MUST/⊗ pair; CHANGELOG cites #3322.
